items.title: Proton’s Lumo, a privacy-focused alternative to ChatGPT and Claude, arrives on desktop
items.summary: Proton's new Lumo Desktop app for Windows, Mac, and Linux lets users automate tasks across files and connected apps, with granular controls over what its AI can access.
items.creator: Sarah Perez

items.title: AI models can be tricked into identifying civilians as military targets by telling them it’s a game
items.summary: Vals, a San Francisco-based AI evaluation startup, tested whether leading AI models could be manipulated into participating in autonomous warfare. They usually compiled.
items.creator: Kirsten Korosec, Rebecca Bellan
